name: Fast In Mass 2022
information: This competition is taking place in the Grace Church in the beautiful town of Amherst. Come for a day of friendly competition, good food, and interaction with other cubers. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Please also be sure to review the Covid Safety tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition.
